hypothesis: Y033's quorum2 cache benefit was shown only on the circular radius-two neighborhood family. Test without retuning on new bipartite topologies and perturbed cell permutations, using the same seven action slots and nine retained memory assignments.
freeze: All topology generators, graph degree, policies, model budgets, seed cohorts and labels fixed before original first-use; no post-result threshold selection.
setting: Exactly seven active keys per episode of sixteen total motif identities, sixteen cells, eight episodes, nine retained assignments maximum; deterministic active-key generator inherited from Y033.
topologies: fixed_scrambled_ring: ring_reference neighbor cells passed through fixed bijective cell relabeling (cell map (5*cell + 3*seed) mod16) each episode
episodic_scrambled_ring: ring_reference neighbor cells passed through per-episode bijective map (5*cell + 3*seed+3*episode) mod16

five_neighbor_anchored: for active key at index j, legal neighborhood five cells {(2*j + seed+episode + d) mod16 for d in range(5)}, guaranteeing a unique legal matching by using cells at d=0 for j=0..6
policies: matched_sham: observed cache writes but no preferred assignment reads
full: use every currently legal remembered cell
quorum2: use remembered legal assignments only if >=2 distinct currently active keys have legal cached placements
success: TOPOLOGY_TRANSFER if quorum2 has churn <= full in ALL three new topology families and strictly improves in at least two, and preserves >=70% of full-cache churn savings vs sham in ring_reference. MIXED if quorum2 improves in >=1 new topology without full criterion. NEGATIVE otherwise. Report all per-seed churn/search/writes and legal preference use.
controls: Exhaustive Hall matching oracle per episode; require cardinality seven for all
Identical cache-write counts and key occupancy trajectory between paired policies
Zero future knowledge, zero evaluator-only history inputs to policies
No extra cell, key, memory capacity, new policy activation, or accepted-ref mutation
Exact Git parent/prereg/source identity before first use; original scientific archive and one full pytest regression
claim_limit: Finite synthetic bipartite assignment caching, not semantic memory or developmental intelligence.
